A built-in Chinese-English bidirectional pack is included. Selecting "Automatic" will detect the language and translate automatically; manually selecting an installed language pack will prioritize that pack for translation. Selecting an uninstalled language pack will automatically trigger a download (approximately 30–60MB per pack; some packs may require an external network to download). After the download is complete, you can select it.
